pybullet_balloons: Free clipped balloons so their combined lift raises a box to hang at rest inside a target band, without letting any balloon burst on the ceiling. Each colour's lift and each box's mass are hidden, and test levels need balloon combinations never tried in training.
pybullet_boil: Fill each jug under the faucet and boil it on the burner without spilling, then turn the burner off. Training has one jug; the test level has two jugs sharing one burner.
pybullet_bridge: Stand two blocks as legs and glue the rest end to end into a span across them; glued joints weld only after a hidden curing time. Training builds a three-block span, the test level a four-block span.
pybullet_domino: Place as few blue dominoes as possible so that pushing the start domino topples the target. The true friction differs from the robot's belief, and the test level adds a 90-degree turn.
pybullet_fan: Switch banks of fans on and off to blow a ball around walls onto the target cell. Training uses a small open grid; the test level is a 10x9 maze.
pybullet_busyboard: Press switches in the right order to light a requested pattern of lamps. The wiring is hidden, lamps light only after a delay, and driving too many at once trips a breaker.
pybullet_crane: Draw back a hinged ram and release it so it knocks a crate onto a landing pad. How far the crate slides depends on its hidden, material-dependent mass and friction.
pybullet_icerink: Push coloured tiles across an ice rink so each comes to rest on its matching target. Each colour slides with its own hidden friction, and a dark strip brakes tiles that cross it.
pybullet_launcher: Cock a spring launcher so its ball knocks only the red top block off a tower. Launch speed depends on how far the plunger is compressed, and balls are limited.
pybullet_magnets: Steer coloured pieces into their slots by sliding a magnetic wand over the mat. Each colour has a hidden range and polarity, so some pieces follow the wand and one is pushed away.
pybullet_ants: Sort food by whether it attracts ants, and stack food of the same colour. Which colours attract ants must be inferred from where the ants walk.
pybullet_balance: Move blocks between two plates on a balance beam until they carry equal loads, then press the button. The button only works when the plates are balanced.
pybullet_barrier: Toggle two switches to raise or lower the barriers they control. Each barrier moves gradually after its switch changes.
pybullet_blocks: Unstack and restack coloured blocks into the requested towers.
pybullet_circuit: Place two wire connectors between a battery and a bulb and switch the battery on.
pybullet_coffee: Brew a jug of coffee in the machine and pour it into every cup. The jug fills only while it sits in the running machine.
pybullet_cover: Pick and place blocks so that they fully cover the target regions on the table.
pybullet_float: Drop heavy blocks into a pair of connected water tanks to raise the water, then grab the light block floating on top.
pybullet_grow: Pour from jugs onto plants in cups until every plant is grown. A plant grows only when the jug's colour matches its cup.
pybullet_laser: Place mirrors to route a laser beam onto the targets, then switch the laser on. A split mirror both reflects and passes the beam.
pybullet_magic_bin: Drop the named blocks into a bin and turn on its switch to make them vanish.
pybullet_switch: Use a power switch and a colour switch to make a light show the requested colour. Each off-to-on flick of the colour switch advances the colour.
